task: name the SPU branch that selects the zero effective address, its deciding input, and the value's origin

answer.deciding_input: r104 = 0. Written only by fsmbi r104,0x0 at 0x67a4 and il r104,0x1 at 0x6b28 -- kernel-local, no memory, no channel. The console takes this branch too on its first descriptor element, so the branch is NOT the divergence.
answer.ea_value: LS 0x36264 = guest 0x0177cc64 = 0, read by lqr r53,0x36260 + rotqbyi r4,r53,4 at 0x6b24/0x6b2c
answer.producer: stw r0,100(r9) at guest 0x009208fc in __gafMP3 (f_009207d4): payload+0x64 = *(0x0177ce00)
answer.root_cause: The PPU store never executes because cellFsOpen('/dev_flash/sys/external/flashMP3.pic') returns 0x80010006 (ENOENT) -- that firmware file is absent from this environment -- and the guard bc 4,30 at 0x00920858 takes the early-return path.

ab_proof.arm_A_no_flash: cellFsOpen returned 0xffffffff80010006; title tty prints 'Multistream: mp3 failed to load MP3 codec (are you using the correct flash?)'; writes to 0x0177cc64 = 0; refusal at pc 0x06428 ea 0
ab_proof.arm_B_with_flashpic: GOWA_FLASH_DIR=/tmp/N1b-flash with a 64 KB sys/external/flashMP3.pic: cellFsOpen returned 0x0; blockwatch WRITE +0x064 (0x0177cc64) = 0x70dfb700 by guest lr 0x009208f0; payload +0x60 quad becomes 00000000 70dfb700 70dc9000 70dd8000
ab_proof.reading: the zero is caused by the missing firmware file; the refusal then moves to the next descriptor element at pc 0x06510, so this is necessary on the chain but not the whole of it

corrections_to_brief: the refused EA field is payload+0x64, not +0x60: rotqbyi i7 selects the word at quad base + i7, proven 3/3 against mfc_hist in one snapshot and matching refs/rpcs3 SPUInterpreter.cpp:972-978
the ch18 write at pc 0x068e8 is the wrch at 0x068e4 and is sequential with the 0x6848 block, not an alternative path to 0x6404; 0x63e8 has exactly one caller, 0x6b30
fix: supply a real dev_flash containing sys/external/flashMP3.pic (or set GOWA_FLASH_DIR); make tools/regress.sh set GOWA_FLASH_DIR and treat a missing flash tree as an environment problem (exit 2) rather than letting it surface 20 s later as an MFC refusal. Not an SPU change.
